statement: The ballot ranking considers usefulness across progression rather than only endgame.
Fishing ballot boosts fishing XP and efficiency.
Fishing ballot belongs in C tier.
AFK gains probably scale better than fishing efficiency for sampling.
Fishing efficiency can help early players obtain bloaches.
Golden food ballot adds to golden food effect.
Golden food effect helps endgame players more.
The additive golden food bonus is smaller than a stamp bonus.
Golden food ballot belongs in B tier.
Dungeon ballot multiplies dungeon credits and flurbo gains.
Many players still need flurbo upgrades and best in slot dungeon rings.
Dungeon progress still contributes to Tome score.
The dungeon bouquet upgrades into the best sampling necklace.
Dungeon ballot belongs at the top of B tier.
Nugget ballot increases golden nuggets found using the shovel.
Golden nugget ballot is an easy S tier choice.
The previous week's nugget ballot produced enormous gains.
The multiplicative nugget bonus helps newer players who have few instant shovel procs.
Kills per kill ballot increases portal and Death Note kill progress.
Kills per kill belongs in S tier and arguably ranks above nuggets.
Kills per kill benefits players across worlds rather than only a particular progression group.
Kills per kill accelerates reaching world six and pushing world seven.
Kills per kill increases green mushroom kills.
Increasing ballot bonus strength improves every ballot option.
Kills per kill versus nuggets depends on progression but kills per kill likely benefits more players.
Either kills per kill or nuggets is a good vote when both appear.
Guild ballot increases guild points earned from daily logins.
Guild points ballot belongs in F tier.
Join an existing guild instead of starting a new guild.
Lab XP ballot gives an additive XP bonus.
Lab has relatively few XP gain sources.
Lab XP ballot particularly helps players still spending prolonged time in lab.
World seven legendary points provide a lab XP multiplier unavailable to earlier players.
Players need level 210 lab.
Lab levels contribute to Tome skill level score.
Lab XP belongs near the bottom of B tier and benefits many players.
Mining ballot provides additive mining XP and efficiency.
Mining efficiency ranks above fishing but AFK gains likely scale better than either.
Monster cash ballot gives an additive cash bonus.
Stop voting for monster cash because its bonus is too small to matter.
Pushing through worlds provides cash for upgrade vault progression.
Refinery ballot adds refinery cycle speed.
Refinery belongs at the top of A tier.
Many players still struggle with refinery progression and lack troll gear even in world seven.
Refinery is useful but does not merit the same tier as kills per kill.
Sailing ballot multiplies captain XP gain and sailing speed.
Reaching the final artifacts requires enormous sailing speed.
Sailing speed remains important throughout most sailing progression.
Captain levels probably contribute to Tome score.
Sailing speed and captain XP ballot ranks above dungeon flurbos in B tier.
Shrine XP ballot provides a multiplicative XP bonus.
Shrine progression is heavily time gated.
Shrines provide drop rate and carry capacity and respawn rate and crystal spawn chance.
Shrine XP ranks at the top of S tier and helps from world three onward.
Sigil ballot multiplies sigil XP gain.
Sigil XP ballot still requires sigils activated in lab.
Players finishing alchemy will likely access world seven spelunking and sigil syrup.
Sigil syrup makes voting for sigil speed unnecessary.
Newer players should finish unlocking alchemy bubbles before prioritizing sigils.
Spelunking sigil syrup can grant liquids or advance sigil leveling.
Players pursuing red or purple sigils should vote only for S tier options.
Players pursuing advanced sigils should already have plentiful syrups from spelunking.
Sneaking ballot boosts stealth and XP for every ninja twin.
The stated base sneaking bonus is 1.65 times XP and 65 percent stealth.
Sneaking ballot belongs in A tier below refinery.
Sneaking mastery bonuses keep sneaking useful after completing Jade Emporium upgrades.
The creator is actively pushing refinery ranks.
Refinery is used more broadly than sneaking.
Summoning ballot adds XP and multiplies all essence gains.
Essence multipliers are powerful especially with teal essence available.
Summoning belongs at the top of A tier just below S tier.
Trapping and worship XP ballot gives an additive bonus.
Trap XP can be snapshotted and persists after the ballot week changes.
Traps retain their original stats until replaced.
Trapping XP belongs in B tier for nature trap users lacking world seven merit bonuses.
Meritocracy offers a multiplicative XP alternative for nature traps.
The creator's free to play account obtained nature traps.
Printer ballot multiplies resources produced by the printer.
Printer ballot increases output rather than sample size.
Extra printer production remains useful for aluminum atom upgrades in endgame.
Extra printer output helps newer players fund resource based upgrades.
Printer output can support divinity point gains.
Extra printer resources support power of ten efficiency scaling.
Printer output belongs at the top of B tier.
AFK ballot adds fighting and skilling AFK gains for all characters.
AFK gains is the best ballot for sampling and makes a good sampling week.
The AFK gain bonus is especially powerful early.
Meritocracy's statue bonus also improves the dragon statue.
Monument reward multipliers and stronger statues can influence the best sampling week.
AFK gains helps sampling but the creator hesitates to place it in S tier.
Artifact find ballot multiplies artifact discovery chance.
Choose artifact find chance before obtaining all artifacts and sailing speed after obtaining them.
All stats ballot additively increases strength and agility and wisdom and luck for all characters.
The creator's strengthened all stats ballot gives 48 percent.
For low level players the all stats ballot may provide only about 50 stats.
All stats belongs in F tier because it provides little practical benefit.
Liquid ballot boosts generation for all alchemy liquids.
Liquid generation ballot is reportedly multiplicative.
Killroy and alchemy and farming are frequently neglected.
Dismissing liquids as useless for alchemy reflects a misunderstanding of their value.
Construction ballot boosts build rate and construction XP.
Construction ballot is additive rather than multiplicative.
Construction belongs around low B or high C but above golden food.
The displayed catching ballot boosts catching XP and efficiency by 154 percent.
Catching efficiency belongs in C tier alongside other skill efficiency ballots.
Cooking ballot boosts cooking XP and speed.
Cooking speed from the ballot is multiplicative.
Many players cannot yet obtain prismatic Diamond Chef through Arcane Cultist.
Cooking ballot week is a good time to spend some ladles.
Reaching No Meal Left Behind takes significant progression.
Cooking belongs in B tier and should not rank above refinery.
Chopping XP and efficiency belongs in C tier with other skill efficiency ballots.
Divinity ballot multiplies points and adds divinity gains.
Coral Kid makes divinity bonuses relevant in endgame.
Extra divinity points help early divinity players unlock gods.
Divinity ranks above nuggets because it benefits more progression stages.
Defense and accuracy ballot gives an additive bonus to every character.
Defense and accuracy may help fresh accounts push slightly faster.
The creator's free to play account had minimal accuracy or defense issues with vault upgrades.
Defense and accuracy belongs in F tier.
Improve alchemy instead of relying on the defense and accuracy ballot.
Damage ballot multiplies damage against enemies for every character.
Damage multiplier belongs in B tier immediately above golden food.
More damage can help with Emperor kills.
Some world seven players still need damage to kill enemies in one hit.
More damage increases multikill tiers and helps obtain eclipse skulls.
Farming ballot additively boosts crop value and farming XP and next crop chance.
Farming ballot belongs near the top of B tier.
Many players have unfinished farming and farming provides numerous bonuses.
Farming is very slow and harder to progress than sailing.
DNA ballot multiplies new species chance when using DNA.
Repeatedly claim and attempt mutations to brute force new species.
Never vote for the DNA species chance ballot; it belongs in F tier.
The speaker describes low chemical mutation odds and garbled boosted percentages.
Drop rate ballot gives an additive bonus to all characters.
The flat drop rate bonus is too small to justify the initial top S ranking.
Breeding ballot adds egg incubation speed and breeding XP.
Breeding ballot belongs in C tier.
Farm most eggs from mutated mushrooms using Divine Knight.
Wind Walker handles egg progression better than the breeding ballot.
Wait for Meritocracy's XP multiplier before dropping many eggs for breeding XP.
Equinox ballot multiplicatively boosts bar fill rate.
Equinox is one of the largest time gates in the game.
Liquid Investment is an S tier upgrade.
Equinox Symbols provides many extra talent levels.
Matching Scims provides multiplicative damage.
Slow Roast Wiz makes higher waves possible.
Metal Detector enables large golden nugget gains.
Class XP ballot adds monster class XP for all characters.
Additive class XP is the worst ballot option.
Even DNA chance for chemicals is preferable to additive class XP.
The creator criticizes voting for brain coral in merit and additive class XP in ballot.
Always choose an S tier option when available.
Choose A tier options when no S tier option is available.
Avoid B tier or lower options when better choices exist.
